newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell Co raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Newell Co raised to buy.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns equity analyst Constance Maneaty confirmed on Monday that she had raised her rating on Newell Co to buy from attractive because of acquisitions the company is making.
-- Maneaty said she raised her 1997 earnings estimate to $1.87 per share from $1.85, and raised her 1998 estimate to $2.15 from $2.10.
-- She established a 12-month price target of $42 to $45 on the stock.

-- Newell announced plans last Thursday to buy the office products business of Rubbermaid Inc for $246.5 million. It said the deal could be modestly accretive this year, depending on when the deal closess.
